page.overview:
Who is Raminas B'nargin Dalmasca?

King Raminas B'nargin Dalmasca is a non-player character in Final Fantasy XII. King of Dalmasca, he was loved by his people and lived in the Royal Palace of Rabanastre. He is the father of Princess Ashe. He tries to keep his small kingdom safe amid strifing empires.

As the king of a desert kingdom, Raminas dresses lightly in ornamental golden armor pieces and teal cloth. He is bald and has a white beard and brown eyes. He wears an elaborate diadem with tassels hanging to frame his face.

King Raminas was devoted to keeping peace and steering Dalmasca as a neutral party between the warring empires of Archadia and Rozarria, though he seems willing to sacrifice sovereignty for the sake of saving his people from further harm. Ashe looks up to him as a role model for what a good ruler should be like, and ultimately abandons her quest for power after realizing that Dalmasca had never used the Dusk Shard as a weapon for conquest, instead opting for peace and diplomacy.

King Raminas led the people of Dalmasca for many years and ruled his kingdom peacefully. He had one daughter, Ashelia B'nargin Dalmasca, and eight sons. His sons perished from illness and warfare, leaving Ashe the only surviving heir to the throne. Raminas and Marquis Ondore of Bhujerba are sworn friends, and their closeness has led to Ashe calling the Marquis "Uncle Halim".
